name: Black Waves
body:
School necromancy; Level death mage 3, sorcerer/wizard 3

EFFECT

Range 30 ft.

This spell functions as lesser black waves except as above and the damage dealt increases to 1d6/CL (max 10d6).

Additionally, the maximum healing to undead increases to 10.
